summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter dated June 16, 2026, for failure to meet the minimum $15,000,000 Market Value of Publicly Held Shares requirement for continued listing on The Nasdaq Global Market. The company has a 180-day compliance period through December 14, 2026, to regain compliance by closing at or above $15 million for ten consecutive business days. If unable, delisting notification may follow, with appeal rights or potential transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market. No special situation is present; this is a routine disclosure of a listing standard deficiency with no immediate delisting, transaction, or restructuring.
